associations.rationale: The type directly states semisimplicity of K and confines its eigenvalues to the finite root set defined by mu^ord(q) = alpha, but it does not state that K^ord(q) acts as a scalar.
The type directly states that K^ord(q) acts by a nonzero scalar on a finite-dimensional simple module, but it does not state semisimplicity or the eigenvalue-set assertion.
